examples.english: She felt apprehensive about her first day at the new job.
examples.persian: او در مورد اولین روز کاری‌اش در شغل جدید نگران و مضطرب بود.

miniContext: She felt apprehensive about her first day at the new job.

examples.english: The young lawyer was articulate enough to win over the entire jury.
examples.persian: وکیل جوان آنقدر شیوا و روشن صحبت می‌کرد که توانست نظر کل هیئت منصفه را جلب کند.

miniContext: The young lawyer was articulate enough to win over the entire jury.

examples.english: The nurse was compassionate with every patient, no matter how busy the ward was.
examples.persian: پرستار با هر بیمار دلسوز بود، مهم نبود بخش چقدر شلوغ بود.

miniContext: The nurse was compassionate with every patient, no matter how busy the ward was.

examples.english: He grew up in an austere household where every penny was carefully saved.
examples.persian: او در خانه‌ای ساده و سخت‌گیرانه بزرگ شد که در آن هر پنی با دقت پس‌انداز می‌شد.

miniContext: He grew up in an austere household where every penny was carefully saved.

examples.english: The manager found a diplomatic way to reject the proposal without offending anyone.
examples.persian: مدیر راهی دیپلماتیک و سنجیده پیدا کرد تا پیشنهاد را بدون ناراحت کردن کسی رد کند.

miniContext: The manager found a diplomatic way to reject the proposal without offending anyone.

examples.english: A good therapist must be empathetic toward clients going through difficult times.
examples.persian: یک درمانگر خوب باید نسبت به مشتریانی که دوران سختی را می‌گذرانند همدل باشد.

miniContext: A good therapist must be empathetic toward clients going through difficult times.

examples.english: The speaker's eloquent farewell speech brought tears to the audience's eyes.
examples.persian: سخنرانی وداع فصیح و شیوای سخنران اشک را در چشمان حضار آورد.

miniContext: The speaker's eloquent farewell speech brought tears to the audience's eyes.

examples.english: She gave a forthright answer instead of avoiding the question.
examples.persian: او به جای طفره رفتن از سوال، پاسخی صریح و رک داد.

miniContext: She gave a forthright answer instead of avoiding the question.

examples.english: The benevolent old man donated most of his fortune to the local orphanage.
examples.persian: پیرمرد خیرخواه بیشتر ثروتش را به پرورشگاه محلی اهدا کرد.

miniContext: The benevolent old man donated most of his fortune to the local orphanage.

examples.english: Even after losing the match, she was gracious toward her opponent.
examples.persian: او حتی پس از باخت در مسابقه، نسبت به حریفش بزرگوار و مودب بود.

miniContext: Even after losing the match, she was gracious toward her opponent.

examples.english: Despite his many awards, the scientist remained humble about his achievements.
examples.persian: دانشمند با وجود جوایز متعددش، درباره موفقیت‌هایش فروتن باقی ماند.

miniContext: Despite his many awards, the scientist remained humble about his achievements.

examples.english: Judges are expected to remain impartial regardless of their personal opinions.
examples.persian: از قضات انتظار می‌رود صرف‌نظر از عقاید شخصی‌شان بی‌طرف بمانند.

miniContext: Judges are expected to remain impartial regardless of their personal opinions.

examples.english: After years of saving, she finally became financially independent from her parents.
examples.persian: او پس از سال‌ها پس‌انداز، سرانجام از نظر مالی از والدینش مستقل شد.

miniContext: After years of saving, she finally became financially independent from her parents.

examples.english: The professor's insightful comments helped students see the novel in a new way.
examples.persian: نظرات بصیرت‌آمیز استاد به دانشجویان کمک کرد رمان را به شکلی جدید ببینند.

miniContext: The professor's insightful comments helped students see the novel in a new way.

examples.english: The editor was meticulous about checking every citation before publication.
examples.persian: ویراستار پیش از انتشار درباره بررسی هر ارجاع بسیار دقیق بود.

miniContext: The editor was meticulous about checking every citation before publication.

examples.english: In the interview, the actor gave a candid account of his struggles with fame.
examples.persian: بازیگر در مصاحبه، روایتی صریح و صادق از دشواری‌هایش با شهرت ارائه داد.

miniContext: In the interview, the actor gave a candid account of his struggles with fame.

examples.english: The detective's perceptive eye noticed the faint fingerprint others had missed.
examples.persian: چشم تیزبین کارآگاه اثر انگشت کم‌رنگی را که دیگران از دست داده بودند متوجه شد.

miniContext: The detective's perceptive eye noticed the faint fingerprint others had missed.

examples.english: The company took a proactive approach to cybersecurity instead of waiting for an attack.
examples.persian: شرکت به جای منتظر ماندن برای یک حمله، رویکردی پیش‌قدم در امنیت سایبری اتخاذ کرد.

miniContext: The company took a proactive approach to cybersecurity instead of waiting for an attack.

examples.english: The audience seemed receptive to the new ideas presented at the conference.
examples.persian: به نظر می‌رسید حضار نسبت به ایده‌های جدید ارائه شده در کنفرانس پذیرا بودند.

miniContext: The audience seemed receptive to the new ideas presented at the conference.

examples.english: The students listened in a respectful silence while the elder told her story.
examples.persian: دانش‌آموزان در سکوتی محترمانه به داستان آن زن مسن گوش دادند.

miniContext: The students listened in a respectful silence while the elder told her story.

examples.english: Stranded without a map, the hikers found a resourceful way to find their way back.
examples.persian: کوهنوردان که بدون نقشه مانده بودند، راهی با تدبیر برای بازگشت پیدا کردند.

miniContext: Stranded without a map, the hikers found a resourceful way to find their way back.

examples.english: It would be sensible to save some of the bonus instead of spending it all.
examples.persian: عاقلانه و منطقی خواهد بود که بخشی از پاداش را پس‌انداز کنیم به جای خرج کردن همه آن.

miniContext: It would be sensible to save some of the bonus instead of spending it all.

examples.english: He offered a sincere apology for forgetting her birthday.
examples.persian: او عذرخواهی صمیمی و صادقانه‌ای به خاطر فراموش کردن تولد او کرد.

miniContext: He offered a sincere apology for forgetting her birthday.

examples.english: The new software uses a sophisticated algorithm to detect fraud in real time.
examples.persian: نرم‌افزار جدید از یک الگوریتم پیشرفته و پخته برای شناسایی تقلب در زمان واقعی استفاده می‌کند.

miniContext: The new software uses a sophisticated algorithm to detect fraud in real time.

examples.english: She was tactful enough to point out the mistake without embarrassing him in front of others.
examples.persian: او به اندازه کافی با ملاحظه بود که اشتباه را بدون خجالت دادن او جلوی دیگران مطرح کند.

miniContext: She was tactful enough to point out the mistake without embarrassing him in front of others.

examples.english: He left a thoughtful note for his roommate before heading out of town.
examples.persian: او پیش از رفتن از شهر، یادداشتی با ملاحظه و سنجیده برای هم‌اتاقی‌اش گذاشت.

miniContext: He left a thoughtful note for his roommate before heading out of town.

examples.english: Good teachers are usually tolerant of small mistakes while students are still learning.
examples.persian: معلمان خوب معمولاً نسبت به اشتباهات کوچک در حالی که دانش‌آموزان هنوز یاد می‌گیرند بردبار هستند.

miniContext: Good teachers are usually tolerant of small mistakes while students are still learning.

examples.english: This small kitchen appliance is versatile enough to blend, chop, and knead dough.
examples.persian: این دستگاه کوچک آشپزخانه به اندازه کافی چندکاره و انعطاف‌پذیر است که می‌تواند مخلوط کند، خرد کند و خمیر ورز دهد.

miniContext: This small kitchen appliance is versatile enough to blend, chop, and knead dough.

examples.english: Locals are wary of strangers who ask too many questions about their property.
examples.persian: افراد محلی نسبت به غریبه‌هایی که درباره املاکشان سوالات زیادی می‌پرسند محتاط و هوشیار هستند.

miniContext: Locals are wary of strangers who ask too many questions about their property.

examples.english: She was willing to work overtime to finish the project on schedule.
examples.persian: او مایل بود اضافه‌کاری کند تا پروژه را طبق برنامه تمام کند.

miniContext: She was willing to work overtime to finish the project on schedule.
